# GAC_com.yftech.multimedia.apk

Full Java-readable decompilation of **`com.yftech.multimedia.apk`**, the the Multimedia HMI app — radio (FM/AM/DAB+), music, video and photo gallery from the [yftech-apks](https://github.com/ammisaidkaidi/yftech-apks) collection.

> Source APK: [com.yftech.multimedia.apk](https://github.com/ammisaidkaidi/yftech-apks/blob/main/com.yftech.multimedia.apk)

> Size: 68.1 MB  
> Decompiled with **jadx 1.5.0** (Java sources) + **apktool 3.0.3** (smali / resources)

## 1. What this app is, what it does, and what it is for

`com.yftech.multimedia` is the **user-facing Multimedia application** of the YF Tech (GAC) head-unit — the screen the driver uses to listen to the radio, play music, watch video and browse photos. Version `1.0.1` (versionCode 2), minSdk 27 / targetSdk 28. Unlike its sibling `com.yftech.media.service`, this APK contains **no services at all**: it is pure UI, split into four in-house libraries — `com.yftech.libradio` (FM/AM tuner + RDS + DAB/DAB+ with EPG, sort/favourite lists and announcements), `com.yftech.libmusic` (USB / hard-disk / CarPlay / CarLife music), `com.yftech.libmedia` (video player) and `com.yftech.libgallery` (photo browser) — glued together by `com.yftech.multimedia.MainActivity` and a shared MVP framework `com.yftech.libmvpmodule`. It talks to the actual audio hardware through the `com.yftech.media.service` binder services and to the car through `com.yftech.vehicle.sdk` / `com.yftech.car.media.data`.

**Purpose / why it exists on the device:**

It is the presentation half of the media stack: `com.yftech.media.service` owns the tuner, the decoders, the scanner and the audio focus, while this app owns the screens, the gestures, the album art, the lyrics, the playlists and the DAB EPG. Keeping them apart means the audio survives a UI crash or a screen change. It is also the app the head-unit launches into when the user presses the physical MEDIA / RADIO / MUSIC / VIDEO buttons — hence the four exported entry activities, each with its own private launch action (`com.yftech.intent.action.start.video`, `…start.music`, `…start.radio`).

**How it works (runtime flow):**

1. `MediaApplication` initialises **Fresco** (Facebook's image pipeline) with `Bitmap.Config.RGB_565` to keep album-art/photo memory low, and registers `org.greenrobot.eventbus` EventBus as the in-app message bus.
2. `MainActivity` hosts `MainFragment` (the media source picker) and `SubjectFragment`, keeps a `Stack<Fragment>` for back navigation, listens for USB insertion/removal through `UsbInformationReceiver` (`ACTION_USB_STATUS_CHANGE_IN_PHOTO_AND_VIDEO`) and exposes a hidden test receiver that maps a broadcast `value` to `com.yftech.intent.action.start.radio.fm` / `…radio.am` / `…music.usb` with `music_source = MUSIC_SOURCE_OF_USB1|USB2` and `isAutoPlay=true`.
3. **Radio**: `libradio.RadioMainActivity` (action `com.yftech.intent.action.start.radio`) plus `RadioListActivity`, `RadioFavorActivity`, the DAB screens `dabui.DabSortListActivity`, `dabui.DabFavorActivity`, `dabui.epg.EpgActivity`, `rds` (RDS/radio-text) and a `carousellayoutmanager` (a 3-D carousel band selector for the station dial). `receiver.AnnounceReceiver` listens for `com.yftech.intent.action.dab.announce.play` so a DAB traffic/announcement can interrupt playback.
4. **Music**: `libmusic.MusicMainActivity` (action `com.yftech.intent.action.start.music`), `ui.MusicListFromHardDiskActivity`, `ui.MusicSearchFromHardDiskActivity`, a lyrics widget (`com.yftech.car.widget.media.music.lyrics`), and `utils/CarLifeMusicManager` + `CarPlayMusicManager` which mirror metadata from CarPlay/CarLife sessions so phone-link music appears in the same UI.
5. **Video / Photo**: `libmedia.player.PlayActivity` (action `com.yftech.intent.action.start.video`) and `libgallery.ui.{FullScreenImageActivity,BrowseImageActivity}` with a full photo-view implementation (`com.yftech.car.widget.media.photo.photoview` — zoom/pan gestures, scroller proxies) and `libgallery` MVP.
6. A large set of custom automotive widgets lives in `com.yftech.car.widget.media.*` (recyclerview, text, video, radio, photo, viewpager2) — these are the head-unit's design-system components.
7. All inter-module communication is EventBus events (`com.yftech.libgallery.event`, `libmusic.event`, `libradio.event`, `com.media.common.event`).

**Notable findings:**

- **This APK bundles a large slice of the Android framework itself** — 216 `android.*` packages including `android.hardware.radio.V1_0` (159 classes), `com.android.internal.widget`, `com.android.internal.os`, `android.media` (188 classes). These are almost certainly framework stubs/HIDL AIDL classes compiled in so the app can be built against hidden APIs; they are *not* the app's own logic, and they explain why the 131 "URLs" found by the scanner are nearly all `content://` framework contract URIs (`content://settings/secure`, `content://mms-sms/…`, `content://contacts/…`, `content://media/…`).
- **Bundles Facebook Fresco** — ~100 packages under `com.facebook.*` (imagepipeline, drawee, animated.gif/webp, nativefilters, soloader) plus `com.facebook.infer.annotation` (the Infer static analyser's annotations). Fresco is used for album art, photo thumbnails and GIF/WebP display.
- **Bundles `bolts`** (Bolts Tasks — Facebook's promise library), `org.greenrobot.eventbus`, `androidx` (AppCompat, RecyclerView, ConstraintLayout, ViewPager2, Transition) and `kotlin`.
- 27 native libraries are loaded, all via Fresco's `SoLoader` / native image pipeline (`bitmaps`, `imagepipeline-native`, `nativeimagetranscoder`, `nativefilters`) — not by the app itself.
- No `sharedUserId` and no `persistent` — unlike every other APK in this collection, this one is a **normal app**, not a system-UID service.
- Permissions are still broad and vendor-specific: `WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS`, `MOUNT_UNMOUNT_FILESYSTEMS`, `SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW`, plus 11 `com.yftech.permission.*` and the two misspelled `com.yftech.persmission.*` (`CAR_READ_STATUS_INFOR`, `READ_SYSTEM_STATUS_INFOR`).
- `allowBackup=true` — the only APK in the collection that allows adb backup.
- `MediaApplication.onTerminate()` releases `CarLifeMusicManager` and `CarPlayMusicManager`, confirming the head-unit merges CarPlay / CarLife / HiCar phone-link sessions into the same music UI.
- Only 13 activities, 0 services, 1 receiver — all the heavy lifting is delegated to `com.yftech.media.service`.
- Crypto primitives found: MD5 and SHA-1/SHA-256 (from the bundled `android.util`/apache/http code, not app logic).

## 3. Repository layout

```
.
├── README.md                  <- this file (full class/function catalogue + analysis)
├── sources/                   <- jadx: decompiled JAVA sources (.java)  **start here**
│   └── <package path>/<Class>.java
├── resources/                 <- jadx: decoded manifest + resources + assets
│   ├── AndroidManifest.xml
│   ├── res/                   <- layouts, drawables, values (near-original form)
│   └── assets/                <- raw asset files (config .properties, etc.)
├── smali/                     <- apktool: disassembled Dalvik bytecode (.smali)
│   └── <package path>/<Class>.smali
├── smali_classes2..N/         <- apktool: extra dex files (when present)
├── original/                  <- apktool: files that could not be decoded (META-INF, …)
├── AndroidManifest.apktool.xml<- apktool copy of the manifest (raw attribute order)
└── apktool.yml                <- apktool build metadata
```

`sources/` is the Java-readable tree — this is what you want to read. `smali/` is the same code in Dalvik assembly (useful when jadx output is ambiguous).
